name: Product Tabs Manager – Custom WooCommerce Product Tabs, Extra Tabs, Tab Editor & Tab Customizer
author: PluginEver

sections.description:
⭐ NEW IN VERSION 1.3.2: Exclude Products & Exclude Categories features are now FREE! ⭐

Product Tabs Manager for WooCommerce lets you create unlimited custom tabs on any WooCommerce product page — no coding required. Whether you need to add specifications, FAQs, size guides, shipping details, or video tutorials, this plugin gives you complete control over how product information is displayed to your customers.

Adding extra tabs is one of the most effective ways to organize product pages without cluttering the layout. Here are some popular ways to use Product Tabs Manager:

  • Product Specifications – List technical details, dimensions, materials, and features in a clean, dedicated tab.
  • FAQ Tabs – Answer common customer questions directly on the product page to reduce support inquiries.
  • Size Guides & Fitting Info – Essential for clothing, shoes, and accessories stores to reduce returns.
  • Shipping & Delivery – Display product-specific shipping details, estimated delivery times, and restrictions.
  • Video Tutorials & Demos – Embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos to showcase products in action.
  • Warranty & Return Policy – Build customer confidence by displaying product-specific warranty and return details.
  • Care Instructions – Share washing instructions, maintenance tips, and care guidelines.
  • Upsell Related Products – Show complementary items, accessories, or cross-sells to increase average order value.
  • Social Proof – Embed customer testimonials, photos, or social media feeds directly in a tab.
  • Legal & Compliance – Add returns policies, financing options, or regulatory information.

💻 Live Demo | 🚀 Get PRO Version | 🛠 Support | 📄 Documentation

Product Tabs Manager (Free) Includes:

  • Create unlimited custom product tabs with rich content using the familiar WordPress editor.
  • Add text, images, shortcodes, HTML, videos, and audio directly into any tab.
  • Apply tabs globally across all products, target specific products or specific categories.
  • Display tab titles and tab content with beautiful Google Fonts for a modern and stylish look.
  • Rename, reorder, or hide WooCommerce’s default tabs (Description, Additional Information, Reviews).
  • Exclude tabs from specific products ⭐ NEW in Free!
  • Exclude tabs from specific categories ⭐ NEW in Free!
  • Drag-and-Drop Tab Sorting – Rearrange tabs intuitively by dragging and dropping them into your preferred order.
  • Disable Default Tabs Globally – Remove WooCommerce’s default tabs across your entire store with a single click.
  • Active/Inactive toggle – Enable or disable tabs instantly without deleting them.
  • Translation ready – Compatible with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, and RTL languages.
  • Works with most WooCommerce themes – Storefront, Flatsome, Astra, OceanWP, Divi, and more.

Product Tabs Manager Pro Includes:

Upgrade to Pro for advanced features that give you even greater control over your product pages:

  • Tab Icons – Add FontAwesome icons to tab titles for enhanced visual appeal and fast content identification.
  • FAQ/Q&A Style Tabs – Create expandable accordion-format question-and-answer tabs, perfect for product FAQs.
  • Product List Tabs – Display related products, upsells, or cross-sells in a dedicated tab to boost average order value.
  • Priority Support – Fast, dedicated support from our expert team with guaranteed response times.

Recommended Integrations

Use Product Tabs Manager alongside other popular PluginEver plugins to build a more powerful WooCommerce store:

  • WC Key Manager – Sell and manage software license keys in WooCommerce.
  • WC Min Max Quantities – Set minimum and maximum purchase quantities per product.
  • Serial Numbers for WooCommerce – Generate and sell serial numbers and license keys.
  • WooCommerce Category Slider – Add beautiful category sliders to your store.

Also explore our premium plugins: WC Discontinued Products Pro | WC Digital Product Checkout | WC Back in Stock Notifier | WC Registration Approval
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Product Tabs Manager“.
  4. Click “Install Now“, then “Activate“.
  5. Navigate to Product Tabs in your admin menu to start creating tabs.

Manual Installation via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and click “Install Now“, then “Activate Plugin“.

Manual Installation via FTP

  1. Unzip the plugin file and upload the product-tabs-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to Plugins → Installed Plugins and activate “Product Tabs Manager”.

Requirements: WordPress 5.2+, WooCommerce 3.0+, PHP 7.4+
sections.faq:
What does Product Tabs Manager do?

Product Tabs Manager lets you create, customize, and manage product tabs on your WooCommerce store. You can add unlimited custom tabs, rename or hide WooCommerce’s default tabs, and organize product information in a tabbed format — perfect for specifications, FAQs, size guides, shipping details, videos, and more.

Can I create tabs for specific categories or products?

Yes. You can create global tabs (all products), category-specific tabs, or product-specific tabs (Pro). You can also exclude specific products or categories from showing certain tabs — this feature is now included in the free version as of v1.3.2.

Can I rename WooCommerce’s default tabs like Description and Reviews?

Yes. You have full control over WooCommerce’s default tabs — rename them, reorder them, or hide them completely.

How do I add icons to my product tabs?

Tab icons are a Pro feature. With Product Tabs Manager Pro, you can choose from FontAwesome icons to add visual appeal to each tab.

Can I embed videos in product tabs?

Yes. Paste a YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted video URL or embed code into the tab content editor and it will display on your product page.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

No. Product Tabs Manager is built with performance in mind. Database queries are optimized, and the plugin works seamlessly with WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket, and CDNs.

Is Product Tabs Manager compatible with WPML and Polylang?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation-ready and works with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and other multilingual plugins.

Is Product Tabs Manager compatible with my WordPress theme?

Product Tabs Manager integrates with WooCommerce’s standard tab system and works with any properly coded WooCommerce theme, including Storefront, Flatsome, Astra, OceanWP, and Divi.

Can I see a demo before installing?

Yes! Visit the live demo to see the plugin in action.

How does the drag-and-drop sorting feature work?

With the Pro version, you can rearrange tabs by dragging and dropping them into your preferred order directly from the admin interface.

Can I add FAQ-style content with expandable questions?

Yes. The Pro version includes a dedicated FAQ/Q&A tab type that displays questions and answers in an expandable accordion format.

Is there a limit to how many tabs I can create?

No. Both the free and Pro versions support unlimited custom tabs.

What happens to my tabs if I deactivate the plugin?

Your tab data is stored in the WordPress database and will remain if you deactivate and reactivate the plugin. Permanently deleting the plugin will also remove the tab data.

Is Product Tabs Manager GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin does not collect any personal data from your customers and is fully GDPR compliant.

Can I use Product Tabs Manager on multiple websites?

The free version can be used on unlimited websites. Pro license terms vary by package — see pluginever.com for details.

Do you offer support?

Yes. Free users can access support through the WordPress.org support forums. Pro users receive priority support through our dedicated support system at pluginever.com/support.
